title: AI Activate 2026 — Bias Flashcards
category: AI Activate 2026 · Addressing Bias in Intelligent Systems

cards.back: A recidivism risk tool used in US courts; ProPublica found it falsely flagged Black defendants as high-risk at roughly twice the rate of white defendants.
When a model trained on past data faithfully reproduces the discrimination embedded in that data — accuracy and fairness are not the same thing.
An experimental recruiting model scrapped because it learned from mostly-male CVs and penalised CVs containing 'women's'.
Systems affecting access to employment or credit (CV-screening, credit-scoring) require oversight, documentation and risk management.
Swapping gendered words does not fully remove NLP bias — it persists in the geometry of embeddings and co-occurrence structure.
The view that algorithmic bias arises from the interaction of data, models and social context, not from code alone.
